title: Use of tacrolimus and MTOR inhibitors with anticipatory therapy vs. tacrolimus and mycophenolic acid in renal recipients at high risk of post-transplant cytomegalovirus.
official: Use of tacrolimus and MTOR inhibitors with anticipatory therapy vs. tacrolimus and mycophenolic acid with universal prophylaxis in renal recipients at high risk of post-transplant cytomegalovirus. Phase IV clinical trial (TIMTOR STUDY).
summary:
Main objective: The primary objective of the study is to assess the time from hospital arrival to revascularization in patients with acute ischemic stroke treated with mechanical thrombectomy, depending on whether the procedure was performed under sedation with HFNC or under general anesthesia.
Monitor CMV-specific cellular immune response before transplantation and at 15, 30 and 90 days post-transplantation in each of the two treatment groups using Quantiferon-CMV.

interventions.name: Valganciclovir Aurovitas 450 mg comprimidos recubiertos con película EFG
Urbason 40 mg polvo y disolvente para solución inyectable
TIMOGLOBULINA 5 mg/ml, polvo para solución para perfusión

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age more than or equal 18 years.
2. Positive pretransplant Ig G CMV serology
3. Receive immunosuppressive induction treatment with thymoglobulin (between 1 and 5 doses).
4. - Agree to participate in the study by signing the informed consent form.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients with negative pretransplant Ig G CMV serology
2. Patients infected with HIV.
3. Patients receiving induction therapy with basiliximab
4. Patients who cannot comply with the follow-up protocol.
5. Patients who cannot receive iMTOR as initial maintenance immunosuppressive therapy, such as patients with chronic kidney disease secondary to hepatorenal polycystic kidney disease and those patients who are expected to undergo complex vascular surgery.
6. Patients who for any reason should not be included in the study according to the evaluation of the research team.
